about: The order of the exam-paper workflow, read by scripts/next_step.py. Steps run one at a time, in this order. A step is next when every step before it is done and it is not. 'by' says who does the step; 'waitsForUser' marks the approval points where work stops until the user answers. 'done' is checked against the task folder (paths are relative to it). 'inputs' and 'outputs' are the files whose hashes next_step.py --done records when the step finishes; a 'recorded' condition is done while those inputs are unchanged and the outputs exist. Format: see next_step.py.

steps.title: Validate the spec
steps.note: If it fails, show the errors verbatim and stop; the user decides how to fix the spec.

steps.title: Make the blueprint
steps.note: CONCEPT_LIST is the concept list found in step 0. If the spec changed after the blueprint was made, the blueprint is out of date.

steps.title: Show the blueprint and get the user's approval
steps.run: Show the blueprint as SKILL.md step 2 says, then ask the user to type /exam-papers:approve blueprint, and wait. Never write approvals.json or change TASK/blueprint.json yourself.

steps.title: Draft questions.json and its diagrams
steps.run: Start the exam-papers:writer subagent by its type (the plugin's agents/writer.md; never pasted into a general-purpose subagent) in draft mode, with the paths SKILL.md step 3 lists. It writes TASK/questions.json (and TASK/make_diagrams.py with its images) and runs the check itself. Wait for it to finish. Never write or edit questions.json yourself.

steps.title: Check the questions
steps.note: The writer ran this before handing back, so it should pass. If it fails, show the errors verbatim and ask the user; do not fix them yourself.

steps.title: Blind solver
steps.run: Start the exam-papers:blind-solver subagent by its type (the plugin's agents/blind-solver.md; never pasted into a general-purpose subagent) with only two paths: input TASK/review/solver-input.json and output TASK/review/solver-answers.json. Wait for it to finish.

steps.title: Compare the solver's answers with the key
steps.note: Exit code 1 means mismatches, not a failure. Show the output verbatim.

steps.title: Reviewer subagent checks the paper
steps.run: Start the exam-papers:reviewer subagent by its type (the plugin's agents/reviewer.md; never pasted into a general-purpose subagent) with the paths SKILL.md step 5.4 lists (from round 2 on, also the previous round's report and questions, the writer's responses and the output of review_status.py TASK --changes); output TASK/review/reviewer-report.json (it makes TASK/review/reviewer-report.html). Wait for it to finish, then print the findings with python3 "${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/render_review.py" TASK/review/reviewer-report.json --print, show them verbatim and send the user the HTML report.
steps.note: The reviewer runs every round. In rounds 2 and 3 it re-checks its earlier findings and reviews only what changed.

steps.title: Close the review round
steps.note: Exit code 1: the report drops an earlier finding or changes a severity without a note. Show the message and start the reviewer again with it; do not edit the report yourself.

steps.title: The user decides on the open findings
steps.run: Run python3 "${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/review_status.py" TASK and show it verbatim, with the findings it lists under 'Teacher to decide' and 'Disputes' (SKILL.md step 5.6). Ask the user to type /exam-papers:decide accept ... reject ... covering each of them, and wait. Never write decisions.json yourself.

steps.title: The writer addresses the findings
steps.run: Run python3 "${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/review_status.py" TASK and show it. Start the exam-papers:writer subagent by its type in revise mode, with the IDs under 'Writer to address', the IDs under 'Writer to revert' with their before and after text from review_status.py TASK --fixes, the user's instructions, and the paths SKILL.md step 5.7 lists. Wait for it to finish, then show the user TASK/review/writer-response.json and carry on without waiting. next_step.py then sends the paper through the next review round.

steps.title: Approve the final paper
steps.run: Show the final paper and the output of python3 "${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/review_status.py" TASK --fixes (verbatim) as SKILL.md step 5.8 says, then ask the user to type /exam-papers:approve paper, or /exam-papers:decide reject ID to undo a fix, and wait. Never write approvals.json.

steps.title: Build the PDFs
steps.note: Open both PDFs and look at them before delivering.

steps.title: Deliver the PDFs
steps.run: Send both PDFs to the user with the path of TASK and any warnings that remain.
